entityDescription: PHOTONICPARTS works in the field of joining and assembly technologies and production of laser components mainly for the photonic market. Beside laser technology itself, the core know-how of lies in the production of homogeneous large-area solder joints for any materials or material pairings. The focus is on the customer's requirement for a thermally stable and robust solder joint with the lowest thermal and electrical resistance between two or more joining partners. Major fields of application are the packaging, adjustment and thermal management of laser crystals, optics and fiber optics in the markets of laser technology, aerospace and quantum technologies. Example applications are the assembly of laser crystal packages and frequency converter modules. Currently the automated alignment of optical setups is being developed, which enables the customer to remelt the solder-interface and repeatable align optical elements in liquid solder. Both founders have >25years of experience in ultra-short pulse beam source and component development and production due to their former work at FRAUNHOFER ILT and AMPHOS GmbH.

Company description: The Planning Authority (PA) is the national agency responsible for spatial planning in the Maltese Islands. The national agency was established to regulate maritime, urban and rural planning on the Maltese islands. The PA is bound to follow the regulations of the Development Planning Act (1992) of the Laws of Malta, Chapter 552, as per Act VII of 2016. The national agency has a duty to promote a comprehensive sustainable land use planning system:
a. to preserve, use and develop land and sea for this and future generations, whilst having full regard to environmental, social and economic needs;
b. to ensure that national planning policies are unambiguous, accessible and clear to the general public;
c. to deliver regular plans in accordance to needs and exigencies;
d. to identify regional planning shortcomings and address any problems found in relation thereto;
e. to apply scientific and technical knowledge, resources and innovation for the effective promotion of development planning; and
f. to consider public values, costs, benefits, risks and uncertainties involved when taking any decisions.

The Decent Cybersecurity s.r.o. is specialised in designing, implementing, securing and testing the highest security standard blockchain infrastructure. Applying basic types of attacks to real world cases our solution can help our customers secure: supply chain attacks, physical attacks - infrastructure tampering, computer network exploitation, cloud infrastructure multi tenancy and operation, data corruption or modification and also  software and hardware vulnerabilities.

Services offered:
Private Blockchain
- Customised Integration: Private blockchains running on DCore protocol can be flexibly customiszed for individual use cases to meet highest security and performance standards.
- Cloud Hosting or Dedicated Servers: With automated implementation, it’s possible to efficiently deploy infrastructure on AWS/Azure or dedicated infrastructure.

Blockchain & Log Security
- Proving the Integrity and Authenticity of Log Files: Log files are a means to precisely govern all activities in an IT-heavy business. Logs can, however, be manipulated with, if not protected appropriately. Blockchain makes sure your infrastructure logs are free from manipulation and exploits.
-Proving the Integrity of Configuration Files: Using a decentralised system is a guarantee for your configuration files to stay exploit-free inside your infrastructure

Blockchain& IoT
-Top-Notch Security for IoT Devices: Considering the interrelated manner of IoT devices, employing superior security standards is not only essential but critical. By integrating blockchain technology, the number of attacks on IoT devices can be reduced to negligible amounts
-Protecting Smart Homes: In today’s world of what seems to be an uprising of “smart” systems, building a smart home has become easier than ever before—there is a catch, however: privacy compromises. Blockchain offers a solution to interconnect all devices efficiently and in the most secure way possible

Blockchain & SCADA
-SCADA Security: Rogue attacks that can interfere with and alter communication between two parties, known as man-in-the-middle attacks (MITM), can cause devastating damage in critical infrastructure. Blockchain’s advanced security measures can make sure such outcome is easily prevented
- An Extra Layer of Security: With its intrinsic security-focused nature, blockchain can be implemented to existing infrastructures as an additional security layer.
- Hardware & Software Fusion: Our solutions easily combine software and hardware integrations toward absolute efficiency and security.

entityDescription:
RYD Engineering is a European company specialized in high-performance composite materials engineering and their manufacturing process, with headquarters in San Sebastián and Barcelona (Spain). RYD is a 100% privately-owned company.
 
RYD boasts a multidisciplinary engineering team with over 20 years of experience and extensive knowledge in the fields of complex structure design, manufacturing, and assembly, complying with European regulations.
 
They provide a comprehensive service, including FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) material research and qualification for specific environments (temperature, strength, vacuum, radiation, etc.), component construction and qualification. We also conduct physical characterization tests, validate production processes, design parts, molds, and tools, perform economic analysis, prototype and produce parts, as well as industrialize series production. We rely on composite technologies, in-house CNC manufacturing, and Additive Manufacturing of plastic and metallic materials.
 
RYD Engineering has four main business units: space, industrial, automotive and science. Our evolution in these sectors has enabled organic and natural growth, allowing us to participate in increasingly larger projects, leading to more opportunities, internal resources and team expansion.
 
RYD Engineering's strategy is rooted in the constant pursuit of excellence and innovation. Since our inception, the focus has been on pushing the boundaries of material behavior through innovative designs, adding extra value. Our mission at RYD is to manufacture structures with high mechanical properties to improve existing solutions and introduce new ones that don't yet exist. This approach translates into reduced component weight, contributing to a global reduction in environmental footprint.
 
Research and development (R&D) are common features across all of RYD's business lines, enabling development and growth, setting it apart from competitors. We have two main R&D strategies: firstly, to enhance existing market products to make them more efficient, competitive, and profitable. Secondly, to launch our own lines of innovative development, enabling next-generation advancements, albeit with a higher development risk, to establish a leadership position in the market.

The Sea Ranger Service is a social enterprise that has pioneered a model which simultaneously creates social and environmental impact. It is on a mission to affect social-economic regeneration of coastal regions whilst improving conservation of the world’s oceans.
The Sea Ranger Service has three primary activities to achieve this mission:

– Training young people to become Sea Rangersas a start to their maritime career
– Carrying out sustainable offshore services and ocean conservation work at sea
– Constructing purpose-built sailing work vessels to carry out this work cost-effectively and clean
The unique entrepreneurial approach which the Sea Ranger Service has developed creatively combines services in youth engagement, shipbuilding, offshore services and environmental conservation to tackle youth unemployment, create modern seafaring jobs and regenerate marine biodiversity globally.

description:
ASTELCO Systems is your partner for professional astronomical telescopes, Optical Ground Stations / Terminals (OGS / OGT) and related accessories of any kind.
To the benefit of research teams all over the world, ASTELCO designs, develops, builds and services advanced mechanical and optical systems, special instrumentation and dedicated software as well as enclosures, domes and towers.
ASTELCO is committed to quality, reliabilty and close connection to science and space industry. ASTELCO has designed a series of Alt-Az telescopes from 0.6m to 3.0m aperture, as well as a series of 0.4 to 0.6m telescopes that can be operated on a universal mount in either Alt-Az, Alt-Alt or equatorial (EQ) mode, reflecting the needs of special applications.
ASTELCO is building Optical Ground Stations for various countries, according to SDA standards.
All designs use industry-leading, state-of-the-art technology. Rather than using old-fashioned style or technique, many details of ASTELCO's telescopes have been re-designed "from scratch", using latest components and technology available to make them more reliable, more stable and more effective in every day's operation.
entityDescription:
ASTELCO Systems is your partner for professional Astronomical Telescopes and related accessories of any kind.
Founded in 2004, as a global leader in advanced optomechanical systems, telescopes, enclosures and hard- and software control solutions, as well as Optical Ground Stations/Terminals according to SDA standards for optical laser communication, ASTELCO offers a broad range of reliable, high-quality and high-precision telescopes, based on industry-leading design and state-of-the-art technology, robotized and fully remotely operated.

ASTELCO builds OGS Optical Ground Stations for SAT-COM / QKD satellite-communications, SLR Satellite Laser Ranging, space awareness, space debris detection, Satellite Tracking & Identification Telescopes, including Laser Guide Star and AO Active / Adaptive Optics technology, as well as Laser Launch Telescopes.

ASTELCO builds completely retractable enclosures, Clamshell domes and fast-rotating domes from 2m to 12m Ø, as well as towers, such as for Seeing-Monitors, and related technology.

The entire ASTELCO team consists of people that have been involved with astronomy, telescopes and telescope control systems for a very long time. Our software engineers have more than 20 years' experience in telescope control.
ASTELCO is committed to quality, reliability and close connection to science.

All ASTELCO products are Made in Germany and are built in one of the ASTELCO facilities in Germany.
Customers include NASA, ESA, ESO, DLR, CNRS, ONERA, ISRO and others.

entityDescription:
Company Overview: Datalya is a specialized technology company that combines the fields of machine learning, remote sensing, and data engineering. Its primary mission is to leverage advanced data analysis techniques to extract valuable insights from remote sensing data related to Canada's geographical landscape. The company operates with a small but highly skilled team comprising remote sensing scientists and data engineers.
Core Focus Areas:
- Remote Sensing Data Curation: Datalya specializes in gathering, processing, and curating remote sensing data. Remote sensing involves the collection of information about the Earth's surface and atmosphere using various sensors mounted on satellites, aircraft, or ground-based platforms. Datalya focuses on collecting and organizing this data, ensuring its accuracy and relevance.

- Integration with Socio-Economic Data: Datalya's unique approach involves combining remote sensing data with socio-economic data. This integration is a critical step that allows the company to provide comprehensive insights to its clients. Socio-economic data includes information about population, economic activities, infrastructure, and more. By merging these datasets, Datalya can offer a holistic view of the relationship between the natural environment and human activities.

Key Services: Datalya offers a range of services to public and private organizations:
- Informed Decision-Making: By providing curated and integrated remote sensing and socio-economic data, Datalya empowers its clients to make informed decisions. This includes decisions related to land use planning, resource management, environmental conservation, disaster risk assessment, and infrastructure development.

- Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Datalya's expertise is instrumental in assessing risks associated with natural disasters, climate change, and other environmental factors. By analyzing historical and real-time data, the company can help clients identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.

- Infrastructure Monitoring: Datalya's capabilities extend to monitoring critical infrastructure, such as transportation networks, utilities, and natural resource extraction sites. Continuous monitoring enables proactive maintenance and enhances the overall resilience of infrastructure systems.

Client Base: Datalya serves a diverse clientele, including government agencies, research institutions, environmental organizations, urban planners, and private companies. These clients benefit from Datalya's data-driven insights to address complex challenges and make evidence-based decisions.
Impact: Through its work, Datalya contributes to sustainable development, environmental conservation, and improved disaster preparedness. The company's insights have the potential to enhance the quality of life for Canadians by fostering more efficient resource management and infrastructure development.
In summary, Datalya is a specialized machine learning company that excels in remote sensing data curation and its integration with socio-economic data. Their work empowers organizations to make informed decisions, assess and mitigate risks, and monitor critical infrastructure, ultimately contributing to the betterment of Canada's diverse and expansive geography.

description:
Qruise develops software that helps scientists and researchers use Machine Learning tools in their day-to-day scientific workflows without having to worry about what's under the hood. ML has revolutionised how science is being done and taking advantage of this new numerical toolset should not require having a full time ML scientist on the team to design, develop and deploy systems. Qruise is developing ML for Science as a productised toolset making ML driven discovery accessible to all. 

Our first offerings address the growing pains of controlling current generation noisy quantum computers (NISQ devices) and provide improvements in operational fidelities through the use of ML & Quantum Optimal Control.

entityName: L-Universita' ta' Malta - Department of Geosciences
entityDescription:
With an ever-increasing awareness of the need for sustainable development, the understanding of geohazards, climate and ecosystem monitoring, vulnerability and risks, resource management and technological advancement, it is clear that a sound knowledge base about our planet, and more specifically, about our national terrestrial, marine and atmospheric environment, will assume more importance in the near future.
Although the Maltese Islands are small in size, there is still much that needs to be better understood about the physical environment of our land and surrounding seas, their interaction with the hydrosphere and atmosphere, their relationship with the surrounding region of the central Mediterranean and the rest of the planet, and the impact on society in general. Moreover, the very nature of Malta’s marine, terrestrial and atmospheric environments link inextricably to the economic and social dimensions of human activity in the country.
The Department of Geosciences within the Faculty of Science is intended to spearhead the response of the University of Malta to these challenges and opportunities. Our Department is largely an applied research institution in the earth-related sciences, founded on a strong base of interdisciplinary science, with a focus on operational oceanography, seismology and geophysics, marine geology, and atmosphere and climate research.
We strive to be a national reference point for matters related to the scientific understanding of the land, marine and atmospheric environments, at local, regional and larger scales. With the launch of the undergraduate course, and a number of postgraduate student opportunities, it aspires to be also an exciting and challenging hub for student participation in fundamental studies and applied research, using the latest technologies and international opportunities.
The primary research areas within the Department of Geosciences are:Atmospheric and Climate Studies; Geology and Geophysics;Operational Oceanography

entityDescription:
The Institute of Aerospace Technologies (IAT) was established by the Council of the University of Malta in 2014. The scope of the Institute is to exploit the strong track record and international reputation that the University has developed in niche areas of aeronautics since the early 2000s and to further extend activity to the broader scope of aerospace. 

The Institute of Aerospace Technologies (IAT) within the University of Malta (UM) hosts one of the strongest research activities of the UM, that in the field of aerospace and aeronautics. The IAT focuses on technologies associated with vehicles operating in the atmosphere and beyond. In the past decade the IAT has attracted over �5 Million in contractual research funding to the University. Through these activities, the Institute has developed a strong and diverse portfolio that ranges from design of safety critical-surveillance systems to airborne Human-Machine Interface (HMI) design, flight operations, trajectory optimisation, air traffic management applications and support activities such as safety assessment, design of experiment, simulation, test and evaluation.

The University of Malta has extensive experience in participation in projects funded under the European Commission Framework Programmes 6 and 7 as well as by the National R&I Programmes. EC-funded projects in which the University of Malta has participated in include FLYSAFE, ALICIA, ODICIS, e-CAB, HIRF-SE, ACROSS, CLEAN SKY and SESAR, whilst those funded by the national R&I programme include CLEAN FLIGHT, TOUCH-FLIGHT, CLEAN FLIGHT 2, SAGRO,eMRO, SMARTCOPTER, SmartFDM, NEVAC, SATMET, ACSAGO, KERS-air, WAGE and BEA. Other international projects include Sino-Malta funded projects such as REACTIVE. Collaborations in these and other projects has involved a wide range of partners, including European industrial primes such as Airbus, Thales, BAE Systems, and Selex ES, national research centres such as CIRA (IT), NLR (NL), DLR (DE) and Onera (FR), airline operators, air navigation service providers and major European universities in the sector.
Through their research activities, IAT academics have published over 150 academic publications and 100 industrial research documents, has MT, US and GB patents granted for inventions in avionics systems and has patents filed for 5 other inventions awaiting award. The IAT has employed over 20 graduates to work on research contracts and has awarded several Masters and Doctoral degrees in the field of avionics and air traffic management.

entityName: L-Universita' ta' Malta - Institute of Space Sciences and Astronomy
entityDescription:
The Institute for Space Sciences and Astronomy (ISSA) at the University of Malta, established in 2014, brings together faculty members from the Science, Engineering, and ICT departments. We engage in a multitude of global collaborations while concurrently advancing our in-house infrastructure to support a wide spectrum of disciplines, including supercomputing capabilities and pioneering theoretical physics research.

Within the realm of big instrument processing, ISSA has garnered notable recognition in both radio and optical astronomy. Our contributions are evident through the publication of numerous journal and conference papers spanning antenna design, signal processing, data acquisition systems, monitoring and control systems, optical instrument optimization, imaging pipelines, and space debris monitoring systems.
Presently, ISSA plays a pivotal role in various ambitious big data instrument initiatives, including the Square Kilometre Array (SKA), Euclid, REACH, CATAMARAN, and the Northern Cross. For the SKA, ISSA is at the forefront, developing software for the data acquisition system of the low-frequency telescope. In the context of EUCLID, ISSA spearheads the design and development of cutting-edge image processing algorithms, set to significantly enhance the instrument's image quality. ISSA assumes the role of digital signal processing leader for the REACH telescope, an instrument with wide-band capabilities designed to measure the 21cm line, allowing it to delve into the cosmic dark ages. At the Northern Cross, ISSA has deployed two pioneering instruments: the BIRALES bi-static radar space debris monitoring system and the Fast Radio Burst (FRB) surveying system. Moreover, ISSA collaborates with INAF in Italy for CATAMARAN, working on the development and benchmarking of machine learning software for radio astronomical source detection, classification, and segmentation methods.
The cosmology research group within ISSA is dedicated to addressing the cosmic tensions problem. We utilize the latest observational data, including the ESA Planck Mission legacy data sets and publicly available data, to explore new physics beyond the standard cosmological model. Our research primarily involves the creation of cosmology simulators, aiming to illuminate how alternative physics can resolve the growing challenges posed by these tensions.

entityDescription: The company SGS ECOLOGY, s.r.o. was founded at the turn of 2021/2022. The trading company was founded on the basis of the increasing demand for solving issues of ecology and the environment in the digital environment. SGS ECOLOGY focuses its activities mainly on the ecological aspects of landscape creation and protection. It covers experts in the fields of ecology, geoinformatics, geology, hydrology, dendrology, climate, etc. SGS ECOLOGY offers a wide range of services for a quality environment.
